      "snippet": "Haha 🧜 totally fair — and that’s actually a great segue into teaching mode!
Let me explain it clearly (and I’ll keep it classroom-friendly since your kids are around 👇).

🪄 What “Mermaid” Means (not Ariel 🧜‍♀️)
Mermaid is a kind of visual code — like drawing with words.
It’s used to make diagrams, timelines, and flow charts right inside tools like ChatGPT, Notion, or Markdown.
So instead of clicking shapes in PowerPoint, you write something like:
mermaidCopy codegraph TD
    A[Start] --> B[Think"
